name: single_choice
description: Present options and let the user pick one.

parameters.name: choices
parameters.description: Array of {label, value, description} objects. A choice MAY also carry an `input` object {name, expected_input_type, prefix, allow_multiple_input, required, serialization} — selecting that choice reveals a typed input (e.g. a path picker), and the entered value is bound to `input.name` (distinct from the tool-level `output`, which records the selected choice value).

parameters.name: allow_custom
parameters.description: Allow user to provide custom input.

usage_guidance: Use when there are distinct alternatives to choose from. For an 'Auto OR provide-your-own' pattern, give one plain choice plus a second choice carrying an `input` spec; the tool-level `output` records the mode (which choice), the choice's `input.name` records the entered value.
examples: {"tool_type": "single_choice", "prompt": "Which optimization strategy?", "choices": [{"label": "Memory", "value": "memory", "description": "Reduce memory footprint"}, {"label": "Latency", "value": "latency", "description": "Reduce inference time"}], "allow_custom": true}

{"tool_type": "single_choice", "prompt": "Where are the modeling artifacts?", "choices": [{"label": "Auto discover", "value": "auto_discover", "description": "Infer from the target repo"}, {"label": "Specify paths", "value": "manual_paths", "input": {"name": "workflow_modeling_artifacts_path", "expected_input_type": "path", "allow_multiple_input": true, "prefix": "{{ session_root_path }}", "required": true}}], "allow_custom": false}
